reason: The source diff changes RENS/RINS heuristic search effort, LP-iteration accounting, symmetry handling inside heuristic LP relaxations, and the heuristic effort limit. These are solver search policies and accounting paths, not model or user-parameter edits.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Earlier effort caps and accurate RENS/RINS LP-iteration accounting can save heuristic work when it does not pay off, while the reduced symmetry adjustment in heuristic LPs can change incumbent discovery and later tree size.
causal_chain: The PR changes the heuristic-effort denominator, counts local RENS/RINS LP iterations and sub-MIP nodes, limits retry effort relative to global LP work, and disables symmetric branch-column adjustment only in heuristic relaxations. These changes can alter when heuristics run, their cost, the first feasible solution, and proof trajectory.
structural_trigger: MIPs on which RENS or RINS creates local search nodes or LP work and the global heuristic-effort test is evaluated; MIPs solved at presolve or without these heuristics are controls.
activation_probe: On both pinned source states, count RENS/RINS entries, local LP iterations and nodes, retry exits, heuristic-effort decisions, and symmetry-adjustment calls; compare incumbent and bound timestamps. Include an inactive control.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze a public activation panel by MIP family and baseline difficulty before hidden scoring; keep hard knapsack and scheduling cases, a no-heuristic control, fixed seeds and budgets, and all normal timeouts.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared HiGHS exact-MIP driver and source probes to establish that the reviewed RENS/RINS or effort-limit path executes on a frozen public case; independently check each returned original-model solution.
mathematical_risk: Heuristic LP symmetry changes or incomplete iteration accounting could admit an invalid incumbent, misstate a dual bound, or consume the proof budget without completing search.
independent_check_plan: Verify returned primal assignments against original constraints, integrality, and objective; compare dual bounds and claimed optimal statuses with independently proven tractable instances; retain infeasibility and timeout outcomes.
hidden_generalization_plan: Evaluate verified solve coverage, proof time and valid timeout-bound progress on paired held-out knapsack and scheduling MIPs across seeds, stratified by family with severe regressions retained.
overlap_review: HiGHS #618 changes branching reliability, while #690 and #693 change cuts and implication storage at later snapshots. This PR is one mixed heuristic-policy change; its six source files and multiple seeds form one task.
resource_risk: Reduced heuristic calls can enlarge the later tree; increased sub-MIP effort or changed incumbent timing can increase total CPU or memory despite local savings.
